whatYouMake: Prairie Pantry makes sauces, marinades, dry rubs and pickles for food brands, grocers and restaurant groups. We produce your recipe or adapt one of our stock formulas, then fill, label and pack it in our Omaha plant.

services.name: Private Label
services.description: Put your brand on one of our proven stock sauces, rubs or pickles. Choose from existing recipes, adjust flavor, and launch with your label.

services.name: Contract Manufacturing
services.description: We scale and produce your own recipe: kitchen trials, scale-up, hot-fill or dry blending, labeling and case packing.

audience: food brands, regional grocers and restaurant groups
differentiators: Recipe scale-up in our test kitchen
